name: LearnMate
description: Agentic AI for Personalized Course Pathways – powered by IBM Granite on IBM watsonx.ai (AICTE Problem Statement #12)

IBM_API_KEY.description: IBM Cloud IAM API key. Get one at https://cloud.ibm.com/iam/apikeys

WATSONX_PROJECT_ID.description: IBM watsonx.ai project ID. Find it in your project → Manage → General at https://dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com

GRANITE_MODEL_ID.description: IBM Granite model ID available in your watsonx.ai environment.

DATA_DIR.description: Directory path where student profile JSON files are stored.

MAX_NEW_TOKENS.description: Maximum number of tokens the model generates per response.

TEMPERATURE.description: Sampling temperature for model responses (0.0 = deterministic, 1.0 = creative).

FLASK_SECRET.description: Secret key used by Flask for session signing. Use a long random string in production.
